name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2461: Sixteen text nodes rendered below the smallest type token at his real window size and nothing in the stylesheet was typed below it. Two font tokens were referenced and never defined, so every use of them silently rendered at its fallback of twelve and ten pixels, and an audit reading the CSS for small numbers would have found nothing wrong. A fallback is a font size nobody reviewed. Also the bottom status strip now says there is more below instead of always showing a half row with no affordance.
